actions.label: Underground Rescue
actions.definition: Covert, illegal liberations; night raids, cage cutting, laboratory extractions (e.g. ALF).

actions.label: Open Rescue
actions.definition: Daylight liberations where activists enter facilities, remove sick/dying animals, and openly claim responsibility.

actions.label: Economic Sabotage
actions.definition: Decommissioning slaughter machinery, cutting fences, disabling hunt vehicles, or arson against exploitation sites.

actions.label: Hunt Sabotage
actions.definition: Direct physical intervention in fields and forests to obstruct hunters, save wildlife, and disarm traps.

actions.label: Direct Confrontation
actions.definition: Street clashes, aggressive resistance, physical blockades, or physical defense against oppressors.

actions.label: Civil Disobedience
actions.definition: Non-violent law-breaking, lock-ons, sit-ins, and slaughterhouse/farm occupations.

actions.label: Bearing Witness
actions.definition: Attending slaughterhouse vigils, offering water to transport trucks, and documenting final moments (e.g. Save Movement).

actions.label: Undercover Investigation
actions.definition: Infiltration, hidden camera documentation, and leaking footage of factory farm or lab abuse.

actions.label: Outreach & Education
actions.definition: Leafleting, street outreach, speeches, lectures, community workshops, and distributing literature.

actions.label: Graphic Truth-Telling
actions.definition: Using shock value, public screens of slaughterhouse footage, or role-reversals to shatter denial.

actions.label: Satire & Parody
actions.definition: Using humor, sarcasm, parody, and mocking songs to expose carnist absurdities.

actions.label: Boycott & Divestment
actions.definition: Refusing to purchase animal products, and lobbying institutions to withdraw funding or investments.

actions.label: Vegan Lifestyle
actions.definition: Adopting and maintaining a 100% plant-based diet, ethical consumption, and straight-edge/lifestyle discipline.

themes.label: Speciesism
themes.definition: Ideological hierarchy of human superiority justifying animal subjugation.

themes.label: Commodification
themes.definition: Turning living sentient individuals into products, meat, inventory, or profit.

themes.label: Industrialization
themes.definition: Assembly-line mechanization, breeding technology, and factory farm efficiency of death.

themes.label: Captivity
themes.definition: Physical confinement in cages, gestation crates, feedlots, tanks, and lab kennels.

themes.label: Slaughter & Killing
themes.definition: The physical act of butchery, slaughterhouses, abattoir floors, and violent termination of life.

themes.label: Animal Suffering
themes.definition: Physical agony, distress, terror, and bodily mutilation experienced by animals.

themes.label: Separation Trauma
themes.definition: Psychological anguish of maternal-infant separation (e.g. dairy calf removal, stolen eggs).

themes.label: Cognitive Dissonance
themes.definition: The psychological contradiction of loving pets while paying for farm animal slaughter.

themes.label: Societal Hypocrisy
themes.definition: Cultural double standards ('pet lovers', 'humane meat' myths, ethical inconsistencies).

themes.label: Apathy & Denial
themes.definition: Willful blindness, looking away, public indifference, and societal normalization of violence.

themes.label: Systemic Violence
themes.definition: State-sanctioned, legal, subsidized, and culturally protected violence against non-humans.

themes.label: Ecological Devastation
themes.definition: Deforestation, grazing destruction, climate heating, and pollution caused by animal agriculture.

themes.label: Wildlife Extinction
themes.definition: Annihilation of wild species, trophy hunting, predator culls, and biodiversity collapse.

themes.label: Human Health & Wellness
themes.definition: Plant-based nutrition, chronic disease prevention, and bodily well-being.

themes.label: Sobriety & Straight-Edge
themes.definition: Clean living, abstinence from intoxicants, and moral discipline connected to animal defense.

moral_frames.label: Animal Rights
moral_frames.definition: The assertion that animals possess intrinsic, non-negotiable legal and moral rights.

moral_frames.label: Abolitionism
moral_frames.definition: Demanding the complete eradication of animal property status and exploitation, rejecting welfarism.

moral_frames.label: Bodily Autonomy
moral_frames.definition: The fundamental right of a sentient individual to govern their own physical body without violation.

moral_frames.label: Sentient Equality
moral_frames.definition: Sentience as the sole and sufficient prerequisite for moral consideration.

moral_frames.label: Care Ethics
moral_frames.definition: An ethical framework rooted in relational care, empathy, and the active drive to prevent suffering.

moral_frames.label: Moral Duty
moral_frames.definition: Deontological obligation: humans have a direct, non-reciprocal obligation to protect non-humans.

moral_frames.label: Stewardship
moral_frames.definition: The ethical responsibility to act as planetary caretakers rather than conquerors.

moral_frames.label: Moral Consistency
moral_frames.definition: The demand to align ethical beliefs with daily behavior (anti-hypocrisy, practice what you preach).

moral_frames.label: Moral Witnessing
moral_frames.definition: The ethical obligation to face the truth, expose systemic lies, and bear witness to victims.

moral_frames.label: Ethical Veganism
moral_frames.definition: Consumption and lifestyle as an active site of moral virtue and commitment to non-harm.

moral_frames.label: Total Liberation
moral_frames.definition: The militant intersectional struggle demanding simultaneous animal, human, and earth liberation.

moral_frames.label: Anarchism
moral_frames.definition: Animal rights grounded in anti-authoritarianism, dismantling state control, and rejecting all hierarchies.

moral_frames.label: Intersectional Solidarity
moral_frames.definition: Analytical mapping connecting speciesism directly with racism, patriarchy, capitalism, or colonialism.

moral_frames.label: Capitalist Critique
moral_frames.definition: Evaluating animal exploitation as a direct, structural necessity of capital accumulation and profit.

moral_frames.label: Atrocity Comparison
moral_frames.definition: Drawing direct moral parallels between animal exploitation and historical human genocides or slavery.

moral_frames.label: Ecocentrism
moral_frames.definition: Intrinsic value attributed to entire ecosystems, wild habitats, and natural planetary processes.

moral_frames.label: Biocentrism
moral_frames.definition: Intrinsic value attributed to all individual living organisms and sentient life forms.

moral_frames.label: Ecological Justice
moral_frames.definition: Prioritizing planetary stability, climate health, and intergenerational environmental equity.

moral_frames.label: Retributive Justice
moral_frames.definition: The moral justification for punishing oppressors, seeking vengeance, or holding exploiters physically liable.

perspectives.label: First-Person Activist
perspectives.definition: Direct first-person call to action or activist voice.

perspectives.label: Animal Point-of-View
perspectives.definition: Narrative delivered from the voice/perspective of a non-human animal.

perspectives.label: Human Observer
perspectives.definition: Human bystander witnessing animal suffering or joy and reflecting on it.

perspectives.label: Metaphorical/Symbolic
perspectives.definition: Lyrics using animals or liberation as allegories or symbols.

perspectives.label: Philosophical/Abstract
perspectives.definition: General theoretical debate on speciesism, ethics, or liberation.

intensity_levels.label: High/Confrontational
intensity_levels.definition: Direct, urgent, and intense challenge to the listener or systems.

intensity_levels.label: Moderate/Appeal
intensity_levels.definition: Ethical or emotional appeals that prompt reflection without high aggression.

intensity_levels.label: Gentle/Implicit
intensity_levels.definition: Gentle expressions of care, connection, or subtle animal mentions.

clarity_levels.label: Highly Explicit
clarity_levels.definition: Direct reference to animal abuse, slaughter, vivisection, or veganism.

clarity_levels.label: Subtle/Metaphorical
clarity_levels.definition: Uses symbolic representation or allegorical language.

clarity_levels.label: Implicit Empathy
clarity_levels.definition: General themes of compassion or care for nature without explicit activist tags.

focus_amounts.label: Central Focus
focus_amounts.definition: The entire song revolves around animals, liberation, or exploitation.

focus_amounts.label: Major Theme
focus_amounts.definition: Multiple verses or a core segment of the song is dedicated to the theme.

focus_amounts.label: Minor Mention
focus_amounts.definition: A brief reference, single line, or passing stanza in the song.
